map.CPM 低就值得投吗？: Does a low CPM make it worth investing?
map.→ 打开KOL（筛选/合作/评估）机制工具: -> Open the KOL (screening / collaboration / evaluation) mechanism tool
map.不一定。CPM 只看「曝光单价」，没看粉丝质量与契合度——一个 CPM 极低但粉: Not necessarily. CPM only looks at the unit price of exposure, not at the quality and fit of the followers - an account with a very low CPM but fake followers or a mismatched tone will not convert no matter how much exposure it gets. This tool places CPM/CPE alongside a four-dimension score, and an account with an overall score below 9 is not worth investing in however low its CPM.
map.合作后回看实际互动，与签约前评分对照，沉淀「评分高但翻车」的预警特征。: After the collaboration, look back at the actual interaction and compare it with the pre-signature score to accumulate warning signs of cases that "scored high but went wrong".
map.同一预算下比较两类 KOL（头部 vs 垂类），用 CPM/CPE 看谁性价比更: Compare two types of KOL (top-tier versus niche) under the same budget and use CPM/CPE to see which offers better value.
map.商务筛选 KOL 时，按粉丝质量、内容创作、品牌契合度、互动表现 4 项各打 0: When screening KOLs commercially, score four items 0-5 each - follower quality, content creation, brand fit and engagement performance - and combine follower count, fee and impressions to compute CPM/CPE for an overall grade.
map.对KOL(关键意见领袖)合作进行全链路评估，涵盖粉丝规模与质量、内容创作能力、品: End-to-end evaluation of KOL (key opinion leader) collaboration across 5 dimensions: follower scale and quality, content creation ability, brand fit, engagement performance and return on investment.
map.综合评分没纳入粉丝量，会漏掉头部 KOL 吗？: The overall score leaves out follower count - does that miss top-tier KOLs?
map.评分衡量「质」，粉丝量/曝光/费用衡量「量价」，是两条线。头部 KOL 通常粉丝: The score measures quality, while follower count, impressions and cost measure scale and price - two separate lines. A top-tier KOL usually has a large following but not necessarily full marks on quality or fit, so the final choice weighs "high-scoring small account" against "low-scoring large account" across dimensions using CPM/CPE. This tool exists to provide one panel for exactly that trade-off.
map.：某科技 KOL：粉丝 500 万、质量5+内容5+契合4+互动4 = 18 分: : a tech KOL with 5 million followers scores quality 5 + content 5 + fit 4 + engagement 4 = 18, judged a preferred KOL; with a fee of 200,000 CNY and 30 million impressions, CPM = 20 / 3000 x 10000 = 66.67 CNY and CPE = 20 / 500 = 0.04 CNY. By contrast a low-quality account scores quality 2 + content 2 + fit 1 + engagement 2 = 7, judged not worth collaborating with; even at a fee of only 50,000 CNY and 1 million impressions, CPM is as high as 500 CNY (7.5 times the preferred KOL), which is extremely poor value.
map.：综合评分 = 粉丝质量 + 内容创作 + 品牌契合度 + 互动表现（各 0~5: : overall score = follower quality + content creation + brand fit + engagement performance (each 0-5, maximum 20); grades: 17 and above preferred KOL, 13 and above viable KOL, 9 and above evaluate with caution, below 9 not recommended. Cost metrics: CPM (cost per thousand impressions) = fee / estimated impressions x 10000 (both fee and impressions in units of ten thousand); CPE = fee / follower count.
